Waiting for your approval to write to `fts5-triggers.sql`. The change replaces the bug comment with:

```sql
-- Sync trigger: DELETE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS frames_ad AFTER DELETE ON frames BEGIN
  INSERT INTO frames_fts(frames_fts, rowid, name, digest_text, inputs, outputs)
  VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name, old.digest_text, old.inputs, old.outputs);
END;
```

This follows the FTS5 external content pattern — the `'delete'` command removes the row from the index using the `old.*` values, matching the first half of the UPDATE trigger.
